decision.explanation: The question asks for the administrative body (city) twinned with Cádiz. Source D1 explicitly states 'Alytus and Cádiz Celebrate 10 Years of Sister City Bond' (D1S1) and details their twinning agreement (D1S3). Source D2 explicitly states 'the port city of Brest... and the municipality of Cádiz... have been twinned' (D2S2) and confirms the agreement was signed in 1986 (D2S4). Both Alytus and Brest are distinct valid referents that satisfy the condition of being twinned with Cádiz. The fallible audits incorrectly label the slot as 'sport', but the text clearly supports 'administrative body' (city) for both candidates. No contradictions exist between the two cities regarding their relationship to Cádiz; they are complementary answers.
